scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d || echo '⚠️ Warning: Docker not found or not running. Skipping database setup. Make sure you have a local PostgreSQL running at localhost:5432.'
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.setup:local: npm run install:all && npm run env:init && npm run db:up && npm run dev
